en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial riverside settlement in a valley. In the foreground is a tree‑lined dirt road with telegraph poles and a wooden house. Beyond it stand several factory buildings with large roofs and many windows, and in the distance a church tower rises above the trees. A river runs along the right side of the scene. A caption is printed at the bottom center.
